data.long_description:
Luxury 4-Bedroom Apartment for Rent in The Address BLVD Sky Collection, Downtown Dubai

Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this exceptional, fully furnished 4-bedroom apartment for rent in the prestigious Sky Collection at The Address Boulevard, Downtown Dubai. Positioned on a high floor, this spacious residence offers elegant living in one of the city’s most iconic addresses—perfect for those seeking a refined, hassle-free lifestyle.

Property Details:

4 Bedrooms
5 Bathrooms
Size: 2,840.06 sq. ft.
Fully Furnished with luxurious interiors
Excellent Condition
High-floor unit with stunning views
Close to supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, and retail shops

About The Address Boulevard:

Located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, The Address Boulevard offers residents direct access to Dubai Mall and Dubai Metro via an exclusive, air-conditioned link bridge. Standing 72 stories tall, the tower features 200 hotel rooms and 542 serviced residences, making it the second tallest building in Downtown and a prominent architectural landmark.

Connectivity:

5 minutes to Dubai Mall
18 minutes to Burj Al Arab
19 minutes to Palm Jumeirah
23 minutes to The Walk, JBR

Airport Access:

17 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB)
45 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport

Company Information:
Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933

For more information or to arrange a private viewing, contact us today. Live the luxury lifestyle you deserve at The Address Boulevard.
